banner.title: THE SPELL DUELING ROSTER AND INDEX - the DMO Appendix (Spell Dueling Characteristics, printed pp. 180-188) and the closing Index (pp. 189-192): the complete per-spell dueling roster, 707 entries in 24 letter sections A through Z (no X or Y - no dueling spells begin with them), each pinned with its school (priest or wizard), level 1-9, usage code (the A/D/L/M/Any bitmask: A 1, D 2, L 4, M 8, Any 16, combinations summed), power rating PR 10-19, movement value MV 1-5 single or ranged, the Tome of Magic dagger mark and the Chapter 5 special-effect asterisk mark.
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 180-192 of the archive.org DMO captures (items dungeon-master-option-high-level-campaigns and tsr02156dmsoptionhighlevelcampaigns; the ABBYY tsr02156 read is primary, the tesseract read cross-checked entry by entry - all 707 rows parsed from the primary band with zero unparsed lines and the usage histogram identical across the handoff audit). STANDING OCR CLASSES, all settled dual-capture: (1) the F class - 38 usage cells read F, a code absent from the legend, cross-checked to the leech code L on every member and pinned as the leech mask 4; (2) the four printed PR exceptions (Consequence PR 15, Disguise PR 19, Fire Shield PR 19, Fumble PR 19) confirmed in both captures and pinned as printed; (3) the Thought Capture usage cell prints a bare digit - confirmed against the physical copy 2026-10-18 and pinned as the no-code value 0; (4) the Barkskin entry prints PR 11 MV 1 without the comma; (5) the marker glyphs garble as digits, letters and quotes in both captures - the dagger (ToM) class reads 1, t, f, r, apostrophe, caret or plus and the asterisk (special) class reads s, 5, 8, quote or star; the two classes were adjudicated entry by entry against the printed legend, the Chapter 5 special dueling characteristics lists (the five groups - mental or debilitating, creature-summoning, illusions, reversible, teleportation - plus the individual abilities) and the Tome of Magic roster itself, including the second-printing Mind Tracker (which replaced Mindkiller) and the wild-magic asterisks of the ToM pages. NAME REPAIRS, each dual-capture verified: Animal Summoning El reads Animal Summoning III; Past Fife reads Past Life; Otiluke's Tele ki netic Sphere reads Telekinetic; Screens reads Screen (the attached s is the asterisk); Far Reaching If reads Far Reaching II (the second I and the dagger merged in both captures); Mind Log reads Mind Fog. Names pinned as the DMO prints them where DMO and the source books differ: Thoughtweave (the ToM prints Thoughtwave), Impending Permission (the ToM prints Impeding Permission), Magical Stone (the PHB prints Magic Stone), The Great Circle seated in the G section as printed. THE INDEX FLIPS HERE: the closing index carries no numbers of its own - the DMO gap report closes at 96 boxes, 96 closed, 0 open, the full arc R599 through R613.
